about: Sprites and overrides of the focus tree, research, technology tree and doctrine windows (UI overhaul lane W3, docs/plans/ui_overhaul/02_plan.md phase 2; design system docs/specs/07_interface/07_design_system.md sections 1.4, 2.1, 4.2, 5.2, 7; K69, K70: these windows are Chronicle). modules/ui_research.mjs builds every texture from generated art only: the chrome sprites are cut from the accepted lane C1 sheet ui-chrome-chronicle, the folder tabs place one engraved emblem of research-emblems-02 on the C1 tab plates, the Sealed Works medallions are the last seven cells of the same sheet, and the technology tree board is research-board-techtree. Code crops, reduces, repeats, masks round and places generated pixels; it never paints.

chrome.name: GFX_zin_research_window
chrome.about: The Chronicle window frame of the research panel (replaces the shared Banner Hall tiled_window2_1b_border in countrytechnologyview).

chrome.name: GFX_zin_research_title
chrome.about: The rubric title cloth of the research panel at the size of the vanilla header_bg it replaces (an iconType draws it at its own size; the shared header_bg is Chancery).

chrome.name: GFX_zin_research_body
chrome.about: Plain slate behind lists (replaces the shared Banner Hall tiled_plain_bg, tiled_generic_overlay_bg1 and tiled_bg in the Chronicle windows).

chrome.name: GFX_zin_research_strip
chrome.about: The bonus strip of the research panel at the size of the vanilla research_top_win it replaces (a background, drawn at the window's size): a quiet inset, so the bonus labels sit on an even ground.

chrome.name: GFX_zin_research_tab
chrome.about: The two tabs of the research panel (vanilla tab_large, 516 x 42, two frames): frame 1 the selected tab (rubric), frame 2 the other (slate); vanilla gives the default tab frame 1.

chrome.name: GFX_zin_research_section
chrome.about: A section plate (replaces the shared Banner Hall tiled_window_transparent in the Chronicle windows).

subjects.zin_arms_folder: a plain kite shield with a sword behind it (Arms and Armour)
subjects.zin_mounts_folder: a riding saddle and stirrup (Mounts and Kin)
subjects.zin_lore_folder: a warding staff with healing herbs (Lore and Wards)
subjects.zin_camp_folder: a covered supply wagon (Camp and Road)
subjects.zin_naval_folder: an oared galley with a square sail (Galleys and Warships)
subjects.zin_skies_folder: a great wing over a crag (Eyries)
subjects.industry_folder: an anvil and hammer (Craft and Works)
subjects.gate_rocket_site: a barred door closed by a wax seal (the First Sealed Work)
subjects.gate_mega_gun: a chained and padlocked coffer (the Second Sealed Work)
subjects.gate_nuclear_reactor: a well capped by a chained stone lid (the Third Sealed Work)
subjects.gate_nuclear_reactor_heavy_water: a jar stopped with wax and cord (the Fourth Sealed Work)
subjects.gate_commercial_reactor: a gateway with its portcullis lowered (the Fifth Sealed Work)
subjects.gate_fuel_silo: a book bound shut with straps and a lock (the Sixth Sealed Work)
subjects.gate_synthetic_refinery: an arch walled up with stone (the Seventh Sealed Work)

tabs.about: A technology folder tab: two frames, frame 1 the selected tab (rubric with a bright bronze line) and frame 2 the others (slate); the vanilla files give the default tab frame 1 (countrytechnologyview research_slots_tab), and the vanilla tab textures draw frame 1 lit. The folder's engraved emblem sits in the middle of both frames.

gate.about: A Sealed Work (grant-only gate technology, never shown): its own engraved medallion, the technology family size (design system 4.2).

boards.name: GFX_zin_techtree_board
boards.about: The technology tree board of every folder window (design system 5.2 rule 5: its own generated plate): the plate's bronze-lined rim at 24 px and its plain slate body, tiled by the engine (tilingCenter).

boards.name: GFX_zin_focus_board
boards.about: The focus tree board (the accepted ui-focus-board plate, also cut for GFX_tiled_focus_bg): its bronze-lined rim at 24 px and its slate body tiled by the engine. The focus window draws it instead of GFX_tiled_focus_bg, whose 495 px vanilla corners stretch a one-pixel middle into streaks.

interface/nationalfocusview.gui.about: The focus tree window draws its own Chronicle textures where vanilla shares Banner Hall ones (the board under the focus tree, the filter panels); the title takes the window title face (design system 2.1). Every element name and position is vanilla.

interface/countrytechnologyview.gui.about: The research panel draws its own Chronicle frame, title cloth and plates where vanilla shares Banner Hall and Chancery textures; the title takes the window title face. Every element name and position is vanilla.
